create_ernie_image_pachifier: create an ErnieImagePachifier instance with a configurable patch size for packing and unpacking latents
pack_ernie_image_latents: pack ErnieImage latents by reshaping and permuting a torch tensor into patch-based layout
unpack_ernie_image_latents: unpack ErnieImage latents by reshaping and permuting a patch-based tensor back to original layout
create_ernie_image_modular_pipeline: create an ErnieImageModularPipeline instance with default height, width, and channel properties
get_ernie_image_pipeline_properties: get ErnieImageModularPipeline properties including vae_scale_factor, num_channels_latents, text_in_dim, and requires_unconditional_embeds
